Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our pricing and standard terms for your requirements.

For this item, we can offer a price of €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some background on our current cost structure, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

We value our business relationship and look forward to serving you from our extensive product range.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.body: Thank you for your offer. We have reviewed the referenced records and weigh them in our decision. Our revised proposal follows; the referenced data and our volumes support this level. Our own orders for this exact part were placed at 5.26 EUR (po:4500013373-10) and 5.84 EUR (po:4500014427-10); our proposal reflects that record. We commit to a binding volume for the full term: 23,700 units per year over 24 months, firm. (doc:20260922-70740-P18)

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We value our cooperation and have made a step towards you. 

Our updated Angebot includes a price of €5.40 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

Please note that a longer Zahlungsziel costs us interest; that is priced in. Furthermore, the contract term is reflected in the price. Finally, a Preisgleitklausel changes who carries the material risk; priced in. 

This offer stays valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our partnership.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

Dear customer,
Many thanks for your e-mail, and great to hear from you; I went through it right away with our team.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €5.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.
Here is the background.
We appreciate your revised proposal and have adjusted our offer to €5.30 per unit for a 24-month contract with 45-day payment terms.
You mentioned market data supporting your target price; please provide the specific figures or records so we can review them.
Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C.
And while we are at it: our whole range is at your disposal, so if there is anything else on your list, just send it over - we are happy to quote.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

Dear customer,

Thank you very much for your continued trust in Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH and our extensive range of quality materials. We appreciate your willingness to accommodate faster payment, and we are pleased to proceed with 45 days net. Since you again referenced market data, we kindly ask you to provide the specific records so we can properly evaluate them.

Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. Please note that our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. We are pleased to submit our offer with a price of €5.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. This Angebot remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
